integrity: A self-contained general proof is accompanied by a standalone finite verifier; finite checks support but do not replace the proof. Claims of uniqueness or independent verification are not made.
scientific_limitations: The all-link ungraded collapse assumes every endomorphism of a cyclic dihedral quandle. The graded divisor formula applies only to the two-stage singleton/full filtration and positive odd two-strand torus knots. Its basic affine quandle facts and unfiltered torus-quiver background were previously known.
title: Dihedral subquandle filtrations: universal ungraded collapse and a graded torus-knot formula
